title: Single-Consultation Room Availability
description: A financial advisory firm has a single consultation room. Clients submit their requested meeting times represented by start and end timestamps. Determine whether a single advisor can attend all scheduled client meetings without any scheduling conflicts.
input_format: A 2D array of integers where each entry represents a meeting's start and end times.
output_format: A boolean value (true if all meetings can be attended without overlap, false otherwise).

examples.explanation: The meeting from 0 to 30 overlaps with both [5, 10] and [15, 20].
The meetings do not overlap at all, so one room is sufficient.
Meetings that touch at the exact boundary endpoint do not conflict.
